operations.name: discovery.manifest
operations.notes: 门面自答:本 manifest + runtime.installed(已装配域);无领域 schema

operations.name: discovery.capabilities
operations.notes: 门面自答:域可用性 / 族与 schemaHash / 会话族 preferred+available(部署级;不含 URL 导航字段,RFC-SDK2-1 §10.5)

operations.name: discovery.session.capabilities
operations.notes: 会话级能力闭合围栏(方案 §3.6 / RFC-UAPI-1 §1.4):{ contract, closureId, authorizationRevision, domains, operations } + 响应头 tansr-closure-id;写操作可携 tansr-closure-id 作前置(412 closure_stale)

operations.name: session.capabilities
operations.notes: 会话族发现 { protocol, contracts[{ contract, availability }] } 内联于 v2/routes.ts,无命名 schema

operations.name: session.create
operations.notes: 201 { sessionId, resumed, lastSeq, ...familyView } 无命名响应 schema;attach / resume / fork 同端点

operations.name: session.list
operations.notes: 响应 { sessions: V2SessionMetaView[], total } 无命名 schema

operations.name: session.close
operations.notes: 202 { sessionId, accepted: true };休眠会话幂等 202

operations.name: session.message.send
operations.notes: 202 { sessionId, accepted: true };事件经 session.events.observe

operations.name: session.events.observe
operations.notes: Last-Event-ID 续订;帧 = KernelEvent(golden kernel-event.schema.json)+ 控制帧 CONTROL_FRAME

operations.name: session.interrupt
operations.notes: 202 { sessionId, accepted: true }

operations.name: session.history.read
operations.notes: 响应 { sessionId, lastSeq, messages[, total, offset] } 无命名 schema

operations.name: session.tool.result
operations.notes: :targetId = toolCallId(doc/98 ⑨ :callId);200 { accepted: true }

operations.name: session.permission.decide
operations.notes: wire 仍为 requestId(/v2 ⑩⑪ 服务端签发票据);统一层按 RFC-UAPI-1 §3 消歧命名 :ticketId(D26 代拍 2026-10-03:/api 观测模板同口径),内部 /v2 / /v3 模板占位为 :targetId

operations.name: session.question.answer
operations.notes: wire 仍为 requestId(/v2 ⑩⑪ 服务端签发票据);统一层按 RFC-UAPI-1 §3 消歧命名 :ticketId(D26 代拍 2026-10-03:/api 观测模板同口径),内部 /v2 / /v3 模板占位为 :targetId

operations.name: session.checkpoint.import
operations.notes: 体 = checkpoint.export 原字节(application/octet-stream,≤ 32 MiB),非 JSON schema;201

operations.name: session.checkpoint.export
operations.notes: 200 application/octet-stream:{ format: "tansr-checkpoint/1", checkpoint, attachments },非 JSON schema

operations.name: session.checkpoint.delete
operations.notes: 204 无体

operations.name: session.audio.transcribe
operations.notes: 响应为平台转写结果透传(doc/123 §3.1),无本仓命名 schema

operations.name: session.audio.speak
operations.notes: 响应为平台合成结果透传(doc/123 §3.2),无本仓命名 schema

operations.name: session.input.capabilities
operations.notes: 响应 = kernel SessionInputCapabilities(字段见 CAPABILITIES session.input.*),contract.ts 无命名 schema

operations.name: session.input.submit
operations.notes: 响应 = kernel SessionInputResult(accepted 携 SessionInputReceipt),contract.ts 无命名 schema

operations.name: session.input.status
operations.notes: :targetId = inputId;响应 = kernel SessionInputReceipt,contract.ts 无命名 schema

operations.name: approval.credential.submit
operations.notes: :id = challengeId;体 { digest, verdict: approve|deny, approver }(RFC-K11 §3.2,无命名 schema);200 { challengeId, result: "accepted" };拒绝经统一信封:unknown_challenge → not_found 404、expired → gone 410、digest_mismatch / already_resolved → conflict 409(detail.submitCode 留原 SubmitCode);approvals 缝未接线 → 404 capability_unavailable

operations.name: execution.status
operations.notes: :targetId = operationId

operations.name: archive.events.observe
operations.notes: Last-Event-ID 续订(独立重放日志 / 游标)

operations.name: archive.artifact.read
operations.notes: :targetId = artifactId

operations.name: archive.operation.query
operations.notes: operation ∈ binding-create(携 sessionId)| archive-ack | material-response | binding-close(携 bindingId);material-response 回 MaterialReceipt

operations.name: archive.sync
operations.notes: 单入口多方法:method 词表 archive-sync-v1#Method(= sdk2/archive-sync.ts methods);value 形随方法;错误形 archive-sync-v1#ErrorResponse(不在统一错误矩阵,经 /api 原样透传);:id = bindingId

operations.name: material.status
operations.notes: :targetId = materialRequestId

operations.name: material.upload.status
operations.notes: :uploadId = artifactId

operations.name: material.upload.chunk
operations.notes: :uploadId = artifactId

operations.name: cache.operation.query
operations.notes: operation ∈ open | renew | rebind | rotate | close

operations.name: cache.core.diagnostics
operations.notes: protocol = sdk2-cache-core-v1

operations.name: terminal.executor.events.observe
operations.notes: :id = executorId;Last-Event-ID = Sequence 游标

operations.name: terminal.output.batch
operations.notes: :id = executorId

operations.name: terminal.execution.state
operations.notes: :id = executorId;:targetId = operationId

operations.name: terminal.output.observe
operations.notes: 输出水位以 afterSeq 续订,不接受 Last-Event-ID

operations.name: terminal.memory.receipt
operations.notes: :targetId = operationId
